settings.title: Extends session endurance
settings.text: Your head sits in the sauna’s highest thermal zone, heating far faster than the rest of your body. A sauna hat buffers this direct heat, preventing premature lightheadedness and allowing your core to comfortably sustain the full duration needed for deep cardiovascular and recovery benefits.

settings.title: Protects hair & scalp health
settings.text: Intense dry heat strips moisture directly from hair fibers, degrading natural keratin and leaving strands brittle, dry, and prone to breakage. Natural wool acts as a thermal barrier, locking in vital hydration and shielding delicate follicles and sensitive ears from heat damage.

settings.title: Balanced thermoregulation
settings.text: By keeping your cranium cool while your body absorbs therapeutic heat, the hat supports steady, uniform vasodilation. This keeps your mind clear and calm throughout the ritual, eliminating common post-sauna fatigue and thermal headaches.

settings.heading:
Built for
the ritual.
settings.lead: Your head sits in the sauna’s highest thermal zone. A wool hat buffers that heat so the session can run longer, clearer, and calmer.

settings.title: Quiet insulation
settings.text: Wool does what synthetic fibers cannot: it creates a breathable, microclimate buffer around your scalp, ears, and hair. Instead of trapping heat against the skin, natural wool fibers trap microscopic pockets of still air—slowing thermal transfer while releasing perspiration vapor. The result is pure, quiet insulation that protects delicate hair from thermal breakage and keeps your head clear, calm, and balanced throughout your session.

settings.title: Rooted in century-old ritual
settings.text: The tradition of the sauna hat is rooted deeply in Northern and Eastern European banya and sauna culture. For centuries, seasoned bathers understood an essential rule of the heat: to sustain the core benefits of deep thermal recovery, the head must remain protected.

settings.title: Sourced with intention: Ukrainian wool
settings.text: We craft our hats from premium Ukrainian wool, celebrated worldwide for its dense, durable structure and enduring natural integrity. Resilient, water-repellent, and naturally antimicrobial, it maintains its structural form and protective density across countless intense sessions.

settings.question: Why wear a sauna hat?
settings.answer: Your head sits in the hottest zone of the sauna. A dense wool hat buffers that heat so you can stay longer, protect hair and scalp, and keep the session clear and calm.

settings.question: Why wool instead of linen or synthetics?
settings.answer: Natural wool creates a breathable microclimate: it slows radiant heat while releasing moisture vapour. Synthetics can trap heat against the skin; linen is lighter but less thermally dense for serious heat.

settings.question: Is one size enough?
settings.answer: Yes. BÖRN uses a flexible one-size felt silhouette shaped to sit securely without tight pressure — suited to most adult heads.

settings.question: How do I care for the hat?
settings.answer: Cool hand wash, reshape while damp, and air dry away from direct heat. Avoid tumble drying. Dense Ukrainian wool holds form across many intense sessions when cared for this way.

settings.question: Do you ship worldwide?
settings.answer: Yes. Shipping is calculated at checkout. Australian design, Ukrainian wool craft, delivered wherever your ritual is.
